chunks: He points thereby to the establishment of his awe in the hearts.
ai.seo_question: What does the establishment of awe in the hearts signify according to As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi interprets this attribute as a divine mechanism for instilling profound reverence (heebah) directly into the hearts of the populace, ensuring obedience without the need for force. This reflects the Shia understanding of the Imam's or Prophet's spiritual authority, where inner conviction is cultivated through the manifestation of divine majesty.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Amīr al-mu’minīn is pointing out his striking of awe in the hearts. [1]
